scope: Independent source/behavior/example semantic review of all 40 operations. Prepared SDK HTTP mocks; no live tenant, upstream, or enrollment claim. PASS is offline semantic approval only. UNCERTAIN requires example evidence before acceptance.

review_boundaries: No source, ledger, ticket, or shared author content was written.
Each judgment applies to the exact behavior/contract/example hashes listed; unrelated concurrent commits do not invalidate unchanged assets.
Model/error definition AST equality and module hashes were checked for all 381 referenced symbols; dependency closure has no missing symbols.
Named error mock envelopes verify SDK decoding, not that a live service would produce each synthetic parameter value.
All source contracts and fixtures were inspected separately from reviewer judgments; fixture success cannot waive invalid business input or misleading output guidance.
